title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
SY489
Advanced Qualitative Analysis
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
builds on previous preparation to provide advanced training in qualitative methods in sociology.
Students
will be required to complete a qualitative empirical study and must also demonstrate mastery in advanced qualitative analyses. Research designs covered may include institutional ethnography, critical discourse analysis, policy analysis, analysis of cultural texts, interactional analysis.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY281
or
PS398
(or permission of the department).
Exclusions
KP462.
